entities.summary: Mario Recordón Burnier nicknamed The Tiger of Osorno was a Chilean architect, athlete and educator. He led Chile to victory in the decathlon in the 1946 South American Athletics Championships and competed in the men's 110 metres hurdles at the 1948 Summer Olympics.
